links.note: Filling in a cheque (date, payee, amount in words and figures, signature) is 31015's paper instrument, item for item.
The PIN belongs to 31014, where cash comes out of an ATM with a debit card and a PIN. 31021 is the OTP, a different credential.
The BSE and its 1875 founding are named inside 31018.
The RBI supervising the banking system is 31011, banker to the banks. 31012 is its currency and rate-setting role.

Internet banking - checking balances and transferring funds online - sits with 31016, the chapter's concept for moving money digitally rather than on paper. No internet-banking concept exists in the set.
Temples lending to artisans and merchants on copper-plate contracts is 31013 exactly.
Debit cards at ATMs and POS machines - 31014, the concept of getting money out of an account.
What a stock exchange does - raising funds for companies and letting individuals invest, which is 31018.
ATM expanded - 31014, where ATMs are described as round-the-clock mini-banks.
POS is where the debit card of 31014 is used for a cashless payment.
The BSE's founding year - stated in 31018.
